Jagannath Temple Observes Period of Seclusion After Ritual Bath

The Jagannath Temple in Puri has entered a 15-day period of seclusion, known as Anasara Niti, following the Deva Snana Purnima ritual. During this time, temple bells and conch shells will not be sounded, and worship practices will undergo specific changes. This period precedes the Rath Yatra festival.
